cards.name: Actual Size
cards.summary: Zooms the active document window to 100%. With Preferences > General > Display Print Size at 100% Zoom on, 100% shows the artwork at its physical print size on screen.
use_for: checking real-size legibility of body copy, icons or a business card at 100%
judging stroke weights and small details of a logo at true scale
resetting the zoom after working zoomed in or out
avoid: checking pixel-level edges of web graphics: turn on View > Pixel Preview as well, 100% alone does not show the raster result
using it to see the whole layout: use Fit Artboard in Window (Ctrl+0) or Fit All in Window
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("actualsize") (id paired from Defaults.kys by its default shortcut, not confirmed by execution). DOM route (unverified): app.activeDocument.activeView.zoom = 1.

review.changes: summary: dropped the vague, unsourced 'one point maps to the screen's base unit' clause

cards.name: Custom View 1
cards.summary: Recalls the first custom view saved in this document with View > New View: the window jumps to the zoom level and scroll position stored in that view. Saved views appear by their own names at the bottom of the View menu; 'Custom View 1' is the slot name the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog uses so a shortcut can be bound to view number 1. Does nothing until at least 1 view is saved.
use_for: jumping straight to a saved close-up (view 1) of a detail you revisit often, such as a logo lock-up or a fine-print area
switching between saved overview and detail views of a large poster or packaging dieline while editing
binding a custom shortcut to saved view 1 for quick navigation
avoid: documents with fewer than 1 saved view: the slot is empty and the command is unavailable; save one first with New View
expecting it to work across files: saved views belong to the document they were made in

cards.name: Edit Views...
cards.summary: Opens the Edit Views dialog, which lists the custom views saved in the document (made with View > New View) so you can rename or delete them. It does not change the current zoom or position.
cards.how: Pick a view in the list, type a new name in the Name field to rename it, or click Delete to remove it; click OK to apply.
use_for: tidying the named views of a long-running multi-artboard document
renaming saved views so the View menu reads clearly for colleagues who open the file
removing stale views after the layout changed
avoid: documents with no saved views: the list is empty, create one with New View first
trying to change the zoom or position stored in a view here: the dialog only renames and deletes; set up the view again and save it with New View
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("editview") (id paired from the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog by words and order only, not confirmed by execution). It only opens the dialog; no DOM call edits saved named views.

review.changes: equivalents: added CDR Window/Dockers/Views, where saved views are renamed and deleted

cards.name: Fit All in Window
cards.summary: Zooms out (or in) and scrolls so that every artboard in the document fits inside the window at once, centred.
use_for: getting an overview of a multi-artboard document such as a social-media set or a brand stationery suite
checking consistency across all artboards before export
finding artwork you lost track of while zoomed in on one artboard
avoid: art that sits on the pasteboard outside the artboards: it may still be off-screen; zoom out further or use the Zoom tool
inspecting one artboard: use Fit Artboard in Window (Ctrl+0)
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("fitall") (id paired from Defaults.kys by its default shortcut, not confirmed by execution). No single DOM call; by hand (unverified): set app.activeDocument.activeView.centerPoint and .zoom from the union of all artboardRect values.

review.changes: none

cards.name: Fit Artboard in Window
cards.summary: Zooms and scrolls so the active artboard fills the window, centred, at the largest zoom that still shows all of it.
use_for: returning to a full view of the current page, poster or label after zooming in on details
framing one artboard for a screenshot or a client walkthrough
checking the overall composition of a single layout
avoid: seeing every artboard at once: use Fit All in Window (Alt+Ctrl+0)
judging real-size detail: use Actual Size (Ctrl+1)
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("fitin") (id paired from Defaults.kys by its default shortcut, not confirmed by execution). DOM route (unverified): read the active artboard's artboardRect and set app.activeDocument.activeView.centerPoint to its centre and .zoom so it fits the window.

review.changes: none

cards.name: Clear Guides
cards.summary: Deletes every guide in the document, both ruler guides and paths that were turned into guides with Make Guides. Ordinary artwork is not touched.
use_for: cleaning a file before handing it to a printer or client
starting a fresh grid of guides for a new layout
removing leftover construction guides from a logo build
avoid: keeping some guides: select and delete only the unwanted ones instead
guides you may need again as shapes: Release Guides turns them back into paths instead of deleting them
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("clearguide") (id paired from the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog by words and order only, not confirmed by execution). DOM route (unverified): loop app.activeDocument.pathItems from the end and remove() each one whose guides is true.

review.changes: none

cards.name: Lock Guides
cards.summary: Toggles guide locking: when locked, guides cannot be selected, moved or deleted, but stay visible and snappable; the menu item then reads Unlock Guides.
use_for: protecting a layout grid while placing and moving artwork over it
stopping accidental drags of margin and bleed guides on a print layout
freeing marquee selections so they only pick up artwork
avoid: editing or releasing guides: unlock them first, locked guides cannot be selected
hiding guides from view: use Hide Guides (Ctrl+;) instead
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("lockguide") (id paired from Defaults.kys by its default shortcut, not confirmed by execution). No DOM property for the guide lock state was found in the harvest.

review.changes: none

cards.name: Make Guides
cards.summary: Turns the selected paths into guides: they lose their fill and stroke and show as non-printing guide lines in the guide colour, keeping their exact shape (curves, circles and angled lines included).
use_for: making a circular or angled construction guide for a logo or badge
turning a safe-area or fold-line rectangle into a non-printing guide on packaging
building a custom layout grid from drawn shapes
avoid: running it with nothing selected: there is nothing to convert
plain horizontal or vertical guides: dragging from the rulers is quicker
expecting the original fill and stroke back later: Release Guides returns a plain path
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("makeguide") (id paired from Defaults.kys by its default shortcut, not confirmed by execution). DOM route (unverified): set pathItem.guides = true on each selected PathItem.

review.changes: none

cards.name: Release Guides
cards.summary: Turns selected guides back into ordinary, printable paths. The released paths come back without the original fill and stroke (typically none/none), so they need an appearance before they show in print. Guides must be unlocked to be selected.
use_for: reusing a construction guide as real artwork, such as a circle guide that becomes a badge outline
editing a guide's shape with the Direct Selection tool and then making it a guide again
recovering a path that was turned into a guide by mistake
avoid: locked guides: unlock them first (Alt+Ctrl+;), otherwise they cannot be selected
removing guides entirely: use Clear Guides
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("releaseguide") (id paired from Defaults.kys by its default shortcut, not confirmed by execution). DOM route (unverified): set pathItem.guides = false on each guide path.

review.changes: none

cards.name: Show Guides
cards.summary: Toggles the display of guides. The live menu walk read Show Guides (guides hidden in that state); when guides are visible the same command reads Hide Guides, the name the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog lists. Guides never print either way.
use_for: checking a clean view of the layout without construction lines
bringing guides back to align artwork to margins, bleeds or a grid
avoid: deleting guides: hidden guides stay in the file; use Clear Guides
assuming the state: it is a toggle, so check the menu label (Show or Hide) before calling it from a script
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("showguide") (id paired from Defaults.kys by its default shortcut, not confirmed by execution). No DOM property for guide visibility was found in the harvest.

review.changes: summary: 'because guides were hidden at harvest time' was a guess; now states what the batch records (live label Show Guides, kbsc_name Hide Guides)

cards.name: Hide Bounding Box
cards.summary: Toggles the bounding box: with it hidden, selected objects show no rectangle with handles, so you cannot scale or rotate by dragging handles with the Selection tool. The menu label flips to Show Bounding Box.
use_for: dragging small objects near their edges without accidentally scaling them
a cleaner view of a selection while judging alignment
restoring the handles when a previous setup left the box hidden
avoid: scaling by eye: the handles are gone while it is hidden; show it again or use the Scale tool
calling it blindly from a script: it is a toggle, check the label first
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("AI Bounding Box Toggle") (id paired from Defaults.kys by its default shortcut, not confirmed by execution). No DOM property for the bounding-box display was found in the harvest.

turning the widgets back on to round corners of a button or badge by dragging

cards.name: New View...
cards.summary: Opens the New View dialog to save the window's current zoom level and scroll position as a named view in the document. Saved views appear at the bottom of the View menu and can be recalled or bound to the Custom View shortcut slots.
cards.how: Set up the zoom and position you want, choose New View, type a name and click OK; rename or delete views later with Edit Views.
use_for: bookmarking close-ups of a large poster, map or packaging dieline you keep returning to
presenting a file step by step by jumping between saved views
pairing with a Custom View shortcut for one-key navigation
avoid: expecting it to save the selection or any change to the artwork: a view only records how the window shows the document
using views across files: they live in the document where they were made
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("newview") (id paired from the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog by words and order only, not confirmed by execution). It only opens the dialog; no DOM call creates a named view.

cards.name: Overprint Preview
cards.summary: Toggles Overprint Preview: the screen simulates how overprinting fills and strokes, knockouts and spot-colour inks will mix on press, so objects set to overprint in the Attributes panel show their blended ink colour instead of knocking out.
use_for: checking overprinted black text or keylines before sending a print job
proofing spot-colour and white-ink packaging or screen-print separations
verifying that trapping strokes overprint as intended
avoid: screen-only or RGB web work: it adds no information and can slow redraw
relying on it as a contract proof: also check Separations Preview and the printer's proof
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("ink") (id paired from Defaults.kys by its default shortcut, not confirmed by execution). No DOM property for the preview mode was found in the harvest.

review.changes: none

standardising grid settings across a series of scenes
